message: I have to admit I'm one of those people who spent the 90s and early 00s only hearing Sparkle Pony used in the negative context documented in the Urban Dictionary definition ( and I think Urban Dictionary is great resource for teaching the changing uses of language over time), so I'm having trouble wrapping my head around the positive usage. I'm now starting to think that this has to do with the fact that I never teach or mentor graduate students. With my university's removal of the writing program, I only teaching writing to first-year students, so this is all a nutty little mindf*ck for me.
